_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_replace_damage.py. t_rd_flail is Inquisitor's Flail -- two replace_damage statics, one filtered on the dealer and one on the recipient, both combat-only -- plus its equip. t_rd_furnace is Furnace of Rath: no filter on either end and no combat clause, so it reaches a burn spell and a player alike. t_rd_bear and t_rd_ogre are creatures to hit and be hit, t_rd_lifelinker proves the gain follows the doubled number, and t_rd_bolt is an instant so a non-combat source can be measured.

cards.name: Test Inquisitor's Flail

abilities.text: If equipped creature would deal combat damage, it deals double that damage instead.
If another creature would deal combat damage to equipped creature, it deals double that damage to equipped creature instead.

cards.name: Test Furnace of Rath
cards.oracle_text: If a source would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.

abilities.text: If a source would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.
